slots.name: portal
slots.description: The component used for the portal element, which contains the menu and its backdrops.

slots.name: positioner
slots.description: The component used to position the menu surface.

slots.name: backdrop
slots.description:
The component used for the optional backdrop beneath the menu.
Providing this slot or `slotProps.backdrop` renders it.
Set to `null` to omit it, including when configured in the theme.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The component used for the menu surface. The popup renders as this element.

slots.name: transition
slots.description: The transition applied to the popup element. Set to null to use CSS animations instead.

slots.name: list
slots.description: The component used for the presentational list wrapper.
